turns.text: What if we get expelled?
turns.zh: 要是我们被开除了怎么办？

turns.text: Nobody ever actually gets expelled.
turns.zh: 从来没人真的被开除过。

turns.text: Ronda Golliver hasn't even been expelled and she's an aorie. Say that's probably why.
turns.zh: 朗达·戈利弗都没被开除，她可是个怪胎。大概就是因为这个吧。

turns.text: I can't find the boys' toilets anywhere.
turns.zh: 我到处都找不到男厕所。

turns.text: It's an old garish gold duck face. There are no boys' toilets.
turns.zh: 那是个老掉牙的俗气金色鸭脸标志。根本没有男厕所。

turns.text: So should I just use the girls' toilets?
turns.zh: 那我是不是就该用女厕所？

turns.text: Oh, you should not, you fucking pervert.
turns.zh: 哦，你可千万别，你个死变态。

turns.text: Yes, I really don't feel great. I feel sort of shaky.
turns.zh: 是啊，我真的感觉不太舒服。我有点发抖。

turns.text: I think my blood sugar's dangerously low.
turns.zh: 我觉得我血糖低得危险了。

turns.text: Seriously, will you just have a marsh bar? What about Kamal? Fuck Kamal.
turns.zh: 说真的，你就吃块棉花糖巧克力棒行不行？卡马尔怎么办？去他的卡马尔。

turns.text: Look, whatever happens in there, we have to sit together, okay? We have to back each other up.
turns.zh: 听着，不管里面发生什么，我们都得坐在一起，好吗？我们得互相撑腰。

turns.text: Ladies.
turns.zh: 女士们。

turns.text: So it had nothing to do with me?
turns.zh: 所以跟我没关系？

turns.text: Yes, okay! I was there, I admit that, but I didn't do anything!
turns.zh: 对，好吧！我当时在场，我承认，但我什么都没做！

turns.text: It was Michelle! It was all Michelle!
turns.zh: 是米歇尔！全是米歇尔干的！

turns.text: I'm not going down for something I didn't do!
turns.zh: 我没做过的事，我可不会背锅！

turns.text: If anyone deserves to get punished, it should be Michelle!
turns.zh: 要是有人该受罚，那也该是米歇尔！

turns.text: Well, I think it's safe to say we all just lost a bit of respect for you there, Claire.
turns.zh: 嗯，我看可以这么说，我们大家刚才都对你有点失去敬意了，克莱尔。

turns.text: This is just so disappointing, girls. I mean, threatening a first year.
turns.zh: 这真是太让人失望了，姑娘们。我是说，威胁一个一年级新生。

turns.text: We didn't threaten her. We're not stupid.
turns.zh: 我们没威胁她。我们又不傻。

turns.text: Big Mandy's her sister and she's half-fucking-gurrallen. That's quite enough, Miss Mallon.
turns.zh: 大曼迪是她姐姐，她可是半个……天哪。够了，马伦小姐。

turns.text: Eh, shouldn't swear, Michelle,
turns.zh: 呃，不该说脏话的，米歇尔，

turns.text: cos when you swear our lady in heaven, she cries,
turns.zh: 因为你说脏话的时候，我们天上的圣母就会哭，

turns.text: her tears then make rain.
turns.zh: 她的眼泪就变成了雨。

turns.text: Isn't that right, Sister Michael?
turns.zh: 对吧，迈克尔修女？

turns.text: What do you do now, Orla? Fifteen.
turns.zh: 你现在怎么办，奥拉？十五。

turns.text: Yeah. You might want to think about wizing up.
turns.zh: 是啊。你也许该想想怎么聪明点。

turns.text: It was all just a misunderstanding.
turns.zh: 这全都只是个误会。

turns.text: I promise, sister. Is that right, Tina? It was a misunderstanding.
turns.zh: 我保证，修女。对吧，蒂娜？是个误会。

turns.text: Look, I didn't even report them. I'm not a grass. I'm saying none.
turns.zh: 你看，我都没举报她们。我不是告密的人。我什么都没说。

turns.text: Is that because you're intimidated by them?
turns.zh: 那是因为你被她们吓住了吗？

turns.text: Oh, you're serious?
turns.zh: 哦，你是认真的？

turns.text: No, I'm not intimidated by them, sister.
turns.zh: 不，我没被她们吓住，修女。

turns.text: OK.
turns.zh: 好。

turns.text: Well, I see no need to take this matter any further.
turns.zh: 好吧，我看没必要再追究这件事了。

turns.text: But if I ever get wind of something like this happening again...
turns.zh: 但要是再让我听到类似的事情发生……

turns.text: Oh, you've won, Sister. Yeah.
turns.zh: 哦，你赢了，修女。是啊。

turns.text: Sister Michael, can I just quickly ask?
turns.zh: 迈克尔修女，我能快速问一下吗？

turns.text: Um, since there's no male student toilets on the premises,
turns.zh: 嗯，既然这里没有男学生厕所，

turns.text: am I permitted to use the staff ones? Absolutely not.
turns.zh: 我可以用教职工的吗？绝对不行。

turns.text: Now, I think you all owe Tina an apology, don't you? - We're very sorry, Tina. - Very sorry, Tina. - Sorry, one. Absolutely not. Now, I think you all owe Tina an apology, don't you?
turns.zh: 现在，我想你们都欠蒂娜一个道歉，对吧？——我们非常抱歉，蒂娜。——非常抱歉，蒂娜。——抱歉，一。绝对不行。现在，我想你们都欠蒂娜一个道歉，对吧？

turns.text: We're very sorry, Tina. Very sorry, Tina. Sorry, Tina. Sorry.
turns.zh: 我们非常抱歉，蒂娜。非常抱歉，蒂娜。对不起，蒂娜。对不起。

turns.text: Tina, do you accept their apology? No.
turns.zh: 蒂娜，你接受他们的道歉吗？不。

turns.text: You don't accept their apology?
turns.zh: 你不接受他们的道歉？

turns.text: Do I have to accept their apology, sister?
turns.zh: 我必须接受他们的道歉吗，修女？

turns.text: I don't suppose you do, no.
turns.zh: 我想你不必，不用。

turns.text: Then I don't. I don't accept it.
turns.zh: 那我就不。我不接受。
